The '''Parliock system''' was located in the [[Ariarch sector/Legends|Ariarch sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Region" /> It shared its name with the [[Peacekeeping of Parliock/Legends|Peacekeeping of Parliock]], a conflict in which members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were involved at some point prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Parliock [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square J-6 as part of the Ariarch [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The Online Companion also erroneously placed the system in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> despite the entirety of the Ariarch sector having previously been established as part of the Mid Rim instead.<ref name="MidRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref>
